page_title: REN 2-2 HAV | Rennes v Le Havre 27/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.

90+6' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Ludovic Blas (Rennes) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Arthur Desmas pulls off a comfortable save.
90+5' Ibrahim Salah (Rennes) gathers a cross inside the box and strikes the ball. He wastes a great scoring opportunity as his shot only hits the right-hand post.
90+2' Luka Elsner decides to make a substitution. Yoann Salmier will be replaced by Oualid El Hajjam (Le Havre).
90+2' Substitution. Yassine Kechta makes way for Nolan Mbemba (Le Havre).
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the middle of the goal, but Arthur Desmas was alert and made an amazing save!
89' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
87' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) watches the ball all the way and fires a first-time shot goalwards from inside the box, but the effort flies just over the bar.
87' Rennes take a short corner kick.

86' Arthur Theate (Rennes) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the right post. The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.
85' Substitution. Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) has come on for Daler Kuzyaev.
84' Jeanuel Belocian (Rennes) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
83' Ibrahim Salah (Rennes) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
82' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
82' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Rennes force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
80' Substitution. Desire Doue in, Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) out.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ibrahim Salah (Rennes) replaces Arnaud Kalimuendo.
80' Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
77' Rennes quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
77' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. Rennes earn a corner.
75' Nemanja Matic (Rennes) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
75' Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) horribly skewed a first-time shot from the edge of the box and sent the ball way wide of the right post.
74' Here is a change. Nabil Alioui is going off and Luka Elsner gives the last tactical orders to Andy Logbo (Le Havre).
74' Today's match ends for Loic Nego who will be replaced by Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre).
73' That was close by Lorenz Assignon (Rennes)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.

70' 2 - 2 Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) strikes the ball towards goal after latching onto a defence-splitting pass on the edge of the penalty box and his shot sails inside the right post to leave the goalkeeper completely stranded!
70' Half-chance! Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) plays a pass into the box, but Arthur Desmas reacts well to snuff out the attack.
69' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

68' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Rennes will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
67' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) whips in the resulting free kick but one of the defenders heads the ball to safety.
65' Jeanuel Belocian (Rennes) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
64' It is time for a substitution. Jeanuel Belocian (Rennes) is on for Adrien Truffert.
64' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
62' Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) makes a bad challenge and is given a second yellow card which means he's off.
61' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 12:5.
58' Loic Nego (Le Havre) controls the ball after receiving a cross, but he slices his shot well wide of the right post.
55' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
55' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
55' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
52' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Amine Gouiri (Rennes) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
50' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
48' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
46' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
45+2' Christopher Wooh (Rennes) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
45+1' The game is interrupted now, Christopher Wooh (Rennes) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
45+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) was quite harsh and Eric Wattellier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
43' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
42' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman makes the right call and Le Havre will have a corner.

40' 2 - 1 Goooooal! Christopher Operi beats his man and slings in a cross towards Nabil Alioui (Le Havre), who evades his marker and plants a fine header into the bottom right corner from close in. 2:1.
38' The free kick is taken by Ludovic Blas (Rennes), but ball is cleared.
37' Loic Nego (Le Havre) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Eric Wattellier blows for a foul. Rennes are awarded the free kick.
34' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
32' Adrien Truffert plays a beautiful lofted pass to Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes), who somehow crashes the ball miles over the bar from a promising position.
31' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block.
30' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) sends a cross into the box, but Steve Mandanda comes off his line to gather the ball.

27' Yoann Salmier (Le Havre) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
27' Le Havre force a corner. They send men into the box.

26' Loic Nego (Le Havre) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee points to the corner flag and Le Havre will take a corner.
24' 2 - 0 Goal! Christopher Wooh (Rennes) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 2:0.
24' Eric Wattellier couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Yoann Salmier (Le Havre) and blew his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Rennes.
23' Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
20' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Eric Wattellier has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
18' Great chance! Adrien Truffert (Rennes) picks up a rebound inside the box, cuts inside his marker but rifles his shot high over the bar.
16' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
15' The Le Havre players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
12' Eric Wattellier sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
11' Wait! Referee Eric Wattellier has indicated he is going to review the Rennes goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.

10' 1 - 0 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Ludovic Blas (Rennes) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a great shot into the bottom right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Arthur Desmas, so the score changes to 1:0.
10' This shall not pass! Ludovic Blas (Rennes) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
8' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
7' The ball is cleared after Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
6' Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
4' Rennes keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Rennes will have the kick-off.
Eric Wattellier will officiate today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
